doc.brief: The possible accessible properties of a [`Accessible`](xref:gtk:Accessible).
doc.md: The possible accessible properties of a [`Accessible`](xref:gtk:Accessible).

autocomplete.brief: Indicates whether inputting text could trigger display of one or more predictions of the user's intended value for a combobox, searchbox, or textbox and specifies how predictions would be presented if they were made.
autocomplete.md:
Indicates whether inputting text
   could trigger display of one or more predictions of the user's intended
   value for a combobox, searchbox, or textbox and specifies how predictions
   would be presented if they were made. Value type: [`AccessibleAutocomplete`](xref:gtk:AccessibleAutocomplete)

description.brief: Defines a string value that describes or annotates the current element.
description.md:
Defines a string value that describes
   or annotates the current element. Value type: string

has_popup.brief: Indicates the availability of interactive popup element, such as menu or popover, that can be triggered by an element.
has_popup.md:
Indicates the availability of interactive
   popup element, such as menu or popover, that can be triggered by an
   element. Contrary to “aria-haspopup”, it doesn't indicate the type of the
   element, as such it cannot be used to indicate the availability of more
   complex elements such as dialog. Value type: boolean

help_text.brief: Defines a string value that provides a description of non-standard keyboard interactions of the current element.
help_text.md:
Defines a string value that provides a description of non-standard keyboard
interactions of the current element. Value type: string

key_shortcuts.brief: Indicates keyboard shortcuts that an author has implemented to activate or give focus to an element.
key_shortcuts.md:
Indicates keyboard shortcuts that an
   author has implemented to activate or give focus to an element. Value type:
   string. The format of the value is a space-separated list of shortcuts, with
   each shortcut consisting of one or more modifiers (`Control`, `Alt` or `Shift`),
   followed by a non-modifier key, all separated by `+`. The
   [WAI-ARIA](https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria/#aria-keyshortcuts) reference
   specifies how to build keyboard shortcuts strings, with specific values
   for each key which are the same regardless of the language, so these
   strings can't be built from localized key names. You can convert an
   accelerator into the matching key shortcuts label with
   `accelerator_get_accessible_label`.
   Examples: `F2`, `Alt+F`, `Control+Shift+N`

label.brief: Defines a string value that labels the current element.
label.md:
Defines a string value that labels the current
   element. Value type: string

level.brief: Defines the hierarchical level of an element within a structure.
level.md:
Defines the hierarchical level of an element
   within a structure. Value type: integer

modal.brief: Indicates whether an element is modal when displayed.
modal.md:
Indicates whether an element is modal when
   displayed. Value type: boolean

multi_line.brief: Indicates whether a text box accepts multiple lines of input or only a single line.
multi_line.md:
Indicates whether a text box accepts
   multiple lines of input or only a single line. Value type: boolean

multi_selectable.brief: Indicates that the user may select more than one item from the current selectable descendants.
multi_selectable.md:
Indicates that the user may select
   more than one item from the current selectable descendants. Value type:
   boolean

orientation.brief: Indicates whether the element's orientation is horizontal, vertical, or unknown/ambiguous.
orientation.md:
Indicates whether the element's
   orientation is horizontal, vertical, or unknown/ambiguous. Value type:
   [`Orientation`](xref:gtk:Orientation)

placeholder.brief: Defines a short hint (a word or short phrase) intended to aid the user with data entry when the control has no value.
placeholder.md:
Defines a short hint (a word or short
   phrase) intended to aid the user with data entry when the control has no
   value. A hint could be a sample value or a brief description of the expected
   format. Value type: string

read_only.brief: Indicates that the element is not editable, but is otherwise operable.
read_only.md:
Indicates that the element is not editable,
   but is otherwise operable. Value type: boolean

required.brief: Indicates that user input is required on the element before a form may be submitted.
required.md:
Indicates that user input is required on
   the element before a form may be submitted. Value type: boolean

role_description.brief: Defines a human-readable, author-localized description for the role of an element.
role_description.md:
Defines a human-readable,
   author-localized description for the role of an element. Value type: string

sort.brief: Indicates if items in a table or grid are sorted in ascending or descending order.
sort.md:
Indicates if items in a table or grid are
   sorted in ascending or descending order. Value type: [`AccessibleSort`](xref:gtk:AccessibleSort)

value_max.brief: Defines the maximum allowed value for a range widget.
value_max.md:
Defines the maximum allowed value for a
   range widget. Value type: double

value_min.brief: Defines the minimum allowed value for a range widget.
value_min.md:
Defines the minimum allowed value for a
   range widget. Value type: double

value_now.brief: Defines the current value for a range widget.
value_now.md:
Defines the current value for a range widget.
   Value type: double

value_text.brief: Defines the human readable text alternative of [`AccessibleProperty.VALUE_NOW`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleProperty#value:VALUE_NOW) for a range widget.
value_text.md:
Defines the human readable text alternative
   of [`AccessibleProperty.VALUE_NOW`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleProperty#value:VALUE_NOW) for a range widget. Value type: string

init_value.brief: Initializes `value` with the appropriate type for the `property`.
init_value.md:
Initializes `value` with the appropriate type for the `property`.

This function is mostly meant for language bindings, in conjunction
with gtk_accessible_update_property_value().
